# Verified PWFAuth SDK package

PWFAuth 1.7.0, exactly as nuget.org serves it (signed by nuget.org):
https://www.nuget.org/packages/PWFAuth/1.7.0

Source: https://github.com/pwfauth/pwfauth-dotnet/releases/tag/v1.7.0

The included NuGet.Config restores it from this directory as an alternative to nuget.org. Other dependencies are restored from nuget.org as usual.
SHA256SUMS.txt identifies the exact package.
This is a public SDK package with a public verification key, not an app secret.
